name: pgstream-walnull-v2
instr:
**Price changes wipe product descriptions in our catalogue service**

We stream our shop database to Kafka with pgstream (wal2json, injector on, keyed by primary key).
Each product has a price, a description, and a sale price that the shop clears (sets to NULL)
when a promotion ends. A second pgstream replicates the topic into our reporting Postgres, and our
catalogue service applies each update event to its own store by setting the columns the event lists.

Since we upgraded, changing only a product's price makes the catalogue lose its description: the
update event lists `description` with a `null` value, although nobody touched it and it's still
in the shop database. Short descriptions come through fine; it's the long ones that get wiped.

The reporting database, fed from the same topic, still has every description, so at first we
blamed the catalogue service.

The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it
there? Please include a regression test, as a _test.go file (say pkg/some/repro_test.go, next to
the code it tests), that fails on the current code because of this problem (a real test failure,
not an import error) and passes once it's fixed.
Test the reported behaviour, not your patch: it should still pass if the bug gets fixed some other correct
way, so no asserting on source text or on helpers only your fix has. It should run on its own
from a clean checkout with just your test files added.
